USDe is a synthetic stablecoin issued by Ethena Labs. USDe is designed to maintain a peg to the US dollar. USDe is backed by crypto collateral that is hedged with short futures positions. USDe is issued on the Ethereum blockchain.

Ronin Network is a sidechain built on Ethereum. Ronin Network was developed to support the Axie Infinity game. Ronin Network uses a proof-of-authority validator set. Ronin Network suffered a breach in March 2022 in which validator keys were compromised.

Poly Network is a cross-chain interoperability protocol. Poly Network connects multiple blockchains to enable asset transfers between them. Poly Network suffered an exploit in August 2021, and the stolen funds were later returned.

Binance Bridge is a cross-chain bridge operated by Binance. Binance Bridge enables token transfers between the BNB Chain and other blockchains. Binance Bridge suffered an exploit in October 2022.
